LITERALS.appInfo1: This application syncs to get information about your training sessions.
LITERALS.appInfo2: The training session data provided is not collected or shared with third parties. All training information obtained comes exclusively from the official API.
LITERALS.appManualInfo1: All the data you enter in this application is not sent or used outside the device.
LITERALS.appManualInfo2: This application stores in local storage data such as the date you started and the exercise records you report.
LITERALS.resetDate: Restart the challenge to start over
LITERALS.resetDateSubtitle: By restarting the challenge you will lose all progress. The start date will start from today, it cannot be undone.
LITERALS.confirmResetSubHeader: Are you sure you want to restart the challenge?
LITERALS.confirmMessage: If you restart the challenge, you will start counting kilometers from NOW
LITERALS.reconectSubtitle: If the application is not working properly or is not reading your activities well, try reconnecting. This will not reset your data or your challenge start date.
LITERALS.welcomeSubtitle: In this exciting application, you will embark on a unique journey through Middle Earth, right from the comfort of your daily workouts. Get ready to challenge your limits as you run or walk through virtual trails that will take you from the peaceful Shire to the imposing dark mountains.
LITERALS.welcome2: Every step you take will bring you closer to your destination, and with every kilometer traveled, you will unlock achievements that will propel you forward. Who said exercise couldn't be exciting? Here, each training session is an opportunity to explore new territories, overcome challenges, and discover your own inner strength.
LITERALS.welcome3: You can manually record distances by adding daily steps or automatically.
LITERALS.welcome31: In "Epic Routes", motivation is our greatest ally. Every day you put on your sneakers and get ready to run or walk, you will be one step closer to becoming the hero of your own story. So go ahead, adventurer! Join us on this epic journey towards physical and mental greatness. Destiny awaits you!
LITERALS.welcome4: Good luck and go for the challenge!
